papers.title: Quantifying changes to solute segregation behaviour at interfaces in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: Electron powder bed fusion has emerged as a promising additive manufacturing process for producing Ti-6Al-4V components with complex geometries. Although prior work has examined microstructural evolution phenomena including how thermal history influences the prevalence of specific α/α grain boundary misorientation intervariants governed by the Burgers orientation relationship between the α and β phases, the solute segregation behaviour at these interfaces remains poorly understood. This study employs correlative transmission Kikuchi diffraction and atom probe tomography to quantify the Gibbsian interfacial excess of V, Fe, and Al across multiple interfaces in electron powder bed fusion produced Ti-6Al-4V. V and Fe exhibited enrichment, while Al was depleted, with V segregation generally increasing with boundary misorientation. Spatial variations in segregation were observed across interface planes, although no consistent trend with boundary curvature was identified. First-principles calculations were also performed on model α/α grain boundaries to evaluate segregation energetics, confirming a thermodynamic preference for V enrichment and Al depletion. The agreement between experimental observations and DFT predictions highlights the influence of local defect structures and atomic-scale interactions on segregation behaviour. These findings improve understanding of grain boundary chemistry in additively manufactured Ti alloys and provide a basis for future grain boundary engineering approaches aimed at tailoring interfacial properties.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了电子粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V中晶界溶质偏析，虽未直接提供力学或疲劳数据，但为界面工程调整力学性能提供了基础。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical or fatigue testing, no tensile, fatigue, or hardness data; purely microstructural/chemical characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解电子粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V中界面溶质偏析行为。
summary_zh.method: 使用透射菊池衍射和原子探针断层扫描量化偏析，并结合第一性原理计算。
summary_zh.result: V和Fe富集，Al贫化；偏析随晶界取向差增加；实验与DFT吻合。
summary_zh.validation: 实验表征与DFT预测对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify and understand solute segregation behavior at grain boundaries in electron beam powder bed fusion manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Correlative transmission Kikuchi diffraction and atom probe tomography were used to measure Gibbsian interfacial excess of V, Fe, and Al, along with first-principles calculations.
summary_en.result: Vanadium and iron segregate, aluminum is depleted, and segregation increases with misorientation, with agreement between experiment and DFT.
summary_en.validation: Experimental quantification is validated by comparison with density functional theory predictions.

papers.title: Effect of plasma electrolytic polishing on the fatigue performance of additive manufactured Ti-6Al-4V removable partial denture clasps

corresponding_authors.name: Minrui Xu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Clinical associate professor, Department of stomatology, Fujian Provincial Governmental Hospital, Fuzhou, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了等离子电解抛光对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V疲劳性能的影响，完全符合后处理控制方向。
llm.why_not_core: Paper does not compare multiple post-processing treatments, but it directly provides experimental fatigue data for PEP on Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究等离子电解抛光对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V可摘局部义齿卡环疲劳性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对激光粉末床熔融成形的Ti-6Al-4V卡环进行等离子电解抛光处理，随后开展疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 等离子电解抛光通过降低表面粗糙度并去除表面缺陷，显著提升了疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验疲劳测试验证了抛光工艺对疲劳性能的改善效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of plasma electrolytic polishing on the fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V removable partial denture clasps.
summary_en.method: Plasma electrolytic polishing was applied to laser powder bed fused Ti-6Al-4V clasps, followed by fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: Plasma electrolytic polishing significantly improved fatigue life by reducing surface roughness and removing surface defects.
summary_en.validation: The improvement in fatigue performance was validated through experimental mechanical fatigue testing.

papers.title: Surface Micro-Patterning of Titanium Alloy Using Multi-Pass Wire-Electrical Discharge Machining for Favorable Biocompatibility
papers.abstract: Abstract Owing to outstanding specific strength and corrosion resistance, titanium alloys are often employed as biomedical implants. The development of an oxide layer over the Ti-6Al-4V alloy surface due to surface modification during the electrical discharge machining (EDM) technique can serve as a corrosion impediment and promote biocompatibility. Surface engineering was used in this work by fabricating micropatterns over Ti-6Al-4V surface employing wire-electrical discharge machining (WEDM) to explore the effects of surface topography, pattern types, and surface roughness on the corrosion resistance, surface wettability, and cell adhesion for enhanced biocompatibility. Samples with various micropatterned surface features and surface topography were produced by the WEDM process. The multipass surface finishing technique was used with a goal of targeted surface modification prior to micropatterning on target surfaces using microchannels and micropillars. The corrosion and surface wettability tests showed that the sample with microchannels using multipass surface finishing provided the highest water contact angle and the lowest corrosion rate under the simulated body fluid. It has been found that the multipass trimmed surface performed better than the single-pass conventional WEDM machined surface in terms of providing favorable corrosion and cell culture performances. The sample with the shallowest microchannels and highest wetting behavior displayed the highest number of attached cells, whereas bacterial adhesion decreased with the increase in microchannel depth. Finally, it has been demonstrated that the implant surface can be tailored by surface patterning using multipass WEDM process for improved biocompatibility.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛合金表面微图案化以改善生物相容性，但未涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的后处理对疲劳或力学性能的影响。

summary_zh.motivation: 通过表面微图案化改善钛合金生物相容性。
summary_zh.method: 使用多线放电加工在Ti-6Al-4V表面制造微通道和微柱。
summary_zh.result: 多线精加工表面提高了耐腐蚀性和细胞粘附。
summary_zh.validation: 腐蚀测试、接触角测量和细胞培养实验。

summary_en.motivation: To improve biocompatibility of titanium alloy implants via surface micro-patterning.
summary_en.method: Multi-pass wire-electrical discharge machining (WEDM) to create micropatterns on Ti-6Al-4V surface.
summary_en.result: Multi-pass trimmed surfaces showed better corrosion resistance and cell adhesion.
summary_en.validation: Corrosion tests, contact angle measurements, and cell culture assays.
